anchor.semantic_hook: Actively supporting something is staged through the literal act of setting one's body into a fixed position directly behind the chosen cause.
anchor.setting: An advocacy hall contains a central cause pedestal surrounded by bays for a city, workplace, school, civic equality, sports, and office scheduling. A colossal human-shaped keyhole is cut deep into the stone floor directly behind whichever cause occupies the pedestal.
anchor.absurd_element: a colossal human-shaped keyhole cut deep into the stone floor

inserts.action: plants both feet inside the keyhole, leans firmly behind the city model, and pushes a tray of young trees toward its bare streets

variations.scene_adjust: add a plain city model, bare street beds, young trees, bicycles, and a watering can to the city bay

inserts.action: stands locked into the keyhole behind the workplace pedestal, braces both hands against an improved workstation, and gestures determinedly toward the surrounding empty employee chairs

variations.scene_adjust: add an adjustable chair, safety helmet, protective gloves, balanced work schedule dial, and several empty employee chairs to the workplace bay

inserts.action: kneels securely in the keyhole, supports the school model with both hands, and smiles toward its newly fitted windows and learning equipment

variations.scene_adjust: add an old school model beside replacement windows, a tablet, an accessible ramp, and modern classroom furniture

inserts.action: sets herself squarely behind two identical open gateways, holds their balance beam level, and watches both routes with unwavering focus

variations.scene_adjust: add two identical open gateways, matching ramps, equal stacks of plain opportunity tokens, and a perfectly level balance beam

inserts.action: steps reluctantly toward the empty keyhole, glances back with a questioning expression, and points toward the unfinished sports field on the pedestal

variations.scene_adjust: add an unfinished turf rectangle, an empty goal frame, a rolled running surface, and idle sports balls

inserts.action: stands authoritatively in the keyhole behind the office schedule dial, spreads its movable clock hands farther apart, and presents the flexible arrangement with an encouraging smile

variations.scene_adjust: add a large dial without digits, freely movable clock hands, several interchangeable work blocks, and an open laptop

anchor.semantic_hook: Putting someone under pressure is staged literally by placing the source of strain on a press plate directly above that person.
anchor.setting: A pressure-testing chamber has a central standing platform with work, school, household, social, and sports equipment stored around it. One building-sized transparent press plate hangs just above the platform, and each active burden is visibly stacked on its upper surface.
anchor.absurd_element: a building-sized transparent press plate hanging over the standing platform

inserts.action: hunches at a cramped desk beneath the press plate, grips the chair arms, and looks upward anxiously at two heavy executive briefcases bearing down on her

variations.scene_adjust: place two heavy executive briefcases, two appointment clocks, and two stacks of blank task sheets on top of the press plate

inserts.action: sits at a school desk under the lowered plate, curls protectively over an exercise book, and stares upward at the towering trophies and perfect models above

variations.scene_adjust: stack trophies, immaculate project models, a flawless globe, and an oversized graduation cap on the press plate

inserts.action: works rapidly beneath the plate with tense shoulders, reaches between several unfinished task trays, and watches the descending clock hands with alarm

variations.scene_adjust: add several clocks with hands close to their final markers, crowded task trays, and a narrow weekly calendar made of blank squares

inserts.action: sits at the household table beneath the plate, holds an empty purse open, and lowers her head as coins and plain payment slips weigh down the surface above

variations.scene_adjust: place an empty purse, a sparse grocery basket, loose coins, utility meters, and plain payment slips around the household table

inserts.action: stands rigidly beneath the plate, holds a phone away from her face, and compares her reflection in a mirror with an increasingly distressed expression

variations.scene_adjust: add a phone displaying only camera and heart icons, a flawless mirror, grooming tools, and a stack of identical portrait frames on the plate

inserts.action: wears training clothes beneath the plate, braces both palms against its underside, and protests toward a newly narrowed obstacle course

variations.scene_adjust: add newly tightened hurdles, a referee whistle, a closed rulebook with a blank cover, and clustered sports equipment

inserts.action: reclines across the folded car seats inside the fallback bay, pulls a travel blanket to her chin, and shrugs calmly toward an empty hotel suitcase

variations.scene_adjust: add a parked car with folded seats, two travel pillows, a blanket, and a closed suitcase beside the failed-option platform

inserts.action: steps through the lifebuoy doorway toward an otherwise empty office desk, rolls up her sleeves, and opens the unfinished project materials with resigned determination

variations.scene_adjust: add an office desk, unfinished project pieces, a seven-column calendar of blank squares with the final column pinned, and an unused weekend picnic basket

inserts.action: stands at the fallback counter, tips tomatoes from an unmarked can into a cooking pot, and gestures matter-of-factly toward the empty produce basket

variations.scene_adjust: add an empty fresh-produce basket, several unmarked cans, loose tomatoes, a can opener, and a cooking pot

inserts.action: chases a row of clocks along the belt, reaches for a planning board held ahead of them, and gestures urgently toward the unsorted task pieces

variations.scene_adjust: add clocks with hands nearing final markers, an empty planning grid, loose task tiles, and a closed organizer box

inserts.action: drops a vacation suitcase beside the belt, bends over a dense stream of accumulated folders, and works through them with exhausted concentration

anchor.semantic_hook: Something happening in the course of a larger event is staged through the literal train or procession of that event, with its consequence traveling immediately behind it.

inserts.action: stands at a classroom desk beside the reform carriage, exchanges a closed old workbook for a tablet, and gestures approvingly toward the digital learning equipment behind
